# Terrarium

> Terrarium turns a fresh Ubuntu VPS into a hardened host for isolated LXD system containers and Linux cloud-image VMs on ZFS, with automatic snapshots, S3 backups, Traefik routing from container labels, and OIDC single sign-on.

## For agents

- [agents.md](https://terrarium.terion.name/agents.md): the complete single-file guide to installing, operating, and building on Terrarium

- [Backups and restore](https://terrarium.terion.name/operations/backups-and-restore)

- [Linux virtual machines](https://terrarium.terion.name/getting-started/virtual-machines): VM profiles, launch/readiness, UI/console, routing, mounts, complete backup sets, recovery, and cluster moves.
